Just last year, Microsoft was hacked by China due to “avoidable errors” in their cybersecurity system.

Elon is putting your sensitive data and other classified information at incredible risk by running it through Microsoft’s AI platform. DOGE needs to stop its work immediately until it can prove it is not putting your personal information in danger.
https://t.co/4IlkiNf0oi

Weeks ago, I raised the alarm about @DOGE running classified information and American's personal data through Microsoft AI.

The news that Microsoft was infiltrated an additional time by Chinese hackers makes it clear that Elon's carelessness is putting your information at risk.
https://t.co/WHZcovOVME

Instead of building clean energy infrastructure and increasing our energy supply to support the expansion of AI, Republicans would rather cut funding for projects that are already underway and ask Americans to take shorter showers.
https://t.co/ZE4N7EK37j

Check out the @USChamber’s new report detailing how small businesses across the country are using AI to improve efficiency, generate new ideas, and more:
https://t.co/Z2fperKLu1

Last week, I spoke with the @sdbizchamber about how we can support small businesses as they begin to utilize AI to strengthen their businesses. Thank you to the business and community leaders for sharing their insights and expertise. https://t.co/c8sDoYwLWB

I am thankful to Rep. Trahan and Rep. Obernolte for their leadership on this critical issue. This discussion draft will not address all of the issues our businesses and families will face, but it is an encouraging first step toward the bipartisan legislation needed to keep pace with the rapid advancement of AI. I really want to hear how the people affected feel about it.

The window to get AI policy right is closing, and Congress can't afford to miss it. I supported Representatives Trahan and Obernolte's initial draft so we could develop a better bill that reflects how this technology works and where it's headed. Thanks to input from researchers, experts, and civil society advocates, that process worked. The FRONTIER Act is a targeted bill with clear, uniform transparency, and safety standards, instead of a fifty-state patchwork. I'm glad to support this bipartisan effort so that Congress acts before this technology outruns us.

CA50 is home to world renowned research institutions solving hard science problems. Congratulations to @ucsandiego and @Scripps_Ocean on receiving a total of roughly $2.5 million to study AI energy efficiency, marine life, earthquake and tsunami risks, and cell migration! Check out the full project details recently awarded by the National Science Foundation:
https://t.co/HIyra5u0Zz

AI is moving faster than Congress is moving to regulate it. That's a problem regardless of party. We need a bipartisan framework that protects Americans without choking off innovation, and I'm ready to work with my Problem Solvers Caucus colleagues to get this done. https://t.co/Cw2Y96fMhU

“The U.S. faces lengthy delays in building the transmission lines and energy components needed to power the development of semiconductors, critical minerals and artificial intelligence.”

Our adversaries, like China, are building energy infrastructure at a rate that far outpaces us meaning they will win any future innovation races if we do not change our processes. 2/5

San Diego's housing crisis represents the biggest barrier to our economic growth and prosperity. For years, I've said the NAVWAR campus is one of our best opportunities to build housing at scale, with direct access to the highway and transit. A data center here – that has not explained how it would benefit the community, build more housing, or lower energy bills – would be a major missed opportunity to do that.
